entry.content: You can now pre-warm an OpenAI-hosted sandbox before attaching it to an Agents API session. OpenAI-hosted sandbox compute is now billed during active turns. You no longer pay for idle time between turns.

entry.title: Faster steering in Codex
entry.content: We’re rolling out faster steering in Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app. When you send a follow-up to steer a running task, Codex can respond to your changes sooner.
